## Your Town Council

The Town of Fogo Island was officially created on March 1st, 2011 by the amalgamation of four existing Towns and one Regional Council.

**Message from the Mayor**

On behalf of the Town Council for the Town of Fogo Island I am pleased to present the Town's Strategic Plan.

Since being elected during the September 2021 Municipal Election, Council has recognized the importance of establishing our Town's priorities. To ensure that all residents had an opportunity to participate in this Plan we conducted a survey to obtain your input and are pleased with the number of residents that took advantage of this opportunity to contribute their ideas.

Following this process Council and our Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) met to reach a consensus on the major initiatives we will undertake on your behalf. Your input through the survey was an important part of this process.

The Town of Fogo Island prides itself on our past accomplishments; however, we believe the best is yet to come. Great things are in store for our community with the completion of our Strategic Plan initiatives.

We encourage you to take the time to review the strategic initiatives we are planning, and we will provide further details in a general meeting and will welcome your feedback.

Together we will make the Town of Fogo Island the ideal place to raise a family, start a business, or visit. Your actions and those of your Council, our employees, volunteers, residents, and business community will make Fogo Island a great place to live, work and play.

Andrew Shea

Mayor

## Watch for the information signs designating these exciting trails!

_Use caution - many areas are steep and rocky. Dress appropriately, take drinking water, and let someone know your itinerary._

Remember...

_**"Take only memories, leave only footprints"**_

[![Brimstone Head Trail](https://www.townoffogoisland.ca/mwm_files/home/sys/media/1535463188.jpg)](https://www.townoffogoisland.ca/mwm_files/home/sys/large/1535463188.jpg "Brimstone Head Trail")

## Brimstone Head Trail

Travel to the top of one of the four corners of the flat earth.

_2 km return (challenging)_

[![Fogo Head / Western Brook Trail](https://www.townoffogoisland.ca/mwm_files/home/sys/media/1535463317.jpg)](https://www.townoffogoisland.ca/mwm_files/home/sys/large/1535463317.jpg "Fogo Head / Western Brook Trail")

## Fogo Head / Western Brook Trail

Breathtaking view of ocean and icebergs.

_3.6 km return (hard)_

[![Fogo Head Trail](https://www.townoffogoisland.ca/mwm_files/home/sys/media/1535463620.jpg)](https://www.townoffogoisland.ca/mwm_files/home/sys/large/1535463620.jpg "Fogo Head Trail")

## Fogo Head Trail

Fogo Head trail is located in the northwest corner of the historic community of Fogo. Hikers will enjoy panoramic views of both the ocean and the community at the summit which stands 338 ft above sea level.

_0.7 Km (moderate to hard)_

[![Joe Batt's Point Trail - Joe Batt's Arm](https://www.townoffogoisland.ca/mwm_files/home/sys/media/1535463981.jpg)](https://www.townoffogoisland.ca/mwm_files/home/sys/large/1535463981.jpg "Joe Batt's Point Trail - Joe Batt's Arm")

## Joe Batt's Point Trail - Joe Batt's Arm

Located at Etheridge's Point Park - Beautiful coastal trail.

_4.6 km return (easy to moderate)_

[![Lion's Den Trail](https://www.townoffogoisland.ca/mwm_files/home/sys/media/1535478320.jpg)](https://www.townoffogoisland.ca/mwm_files/home/sys/large/1535478320.jpg "Lion's Den Trail")

## Lion's Den, Shoal Tickle, Eastern Tickle, and Lock's Cove - Fogo

Located on this trail is the Marconi Site.

_4.2 km return (moderate to hard)_

[![Turpin's Trail](https://www.townoffogoisland.ca/mwm_files/home/sys/media/1535478390.jpg)](https://www.townoffogoisland.ca/mwm_files/home/sys/large/1535478390.jpg "Turpin's Trail")

## Turpin's Trail - Tilting

Located on this trail is the first ground radar station on North America.

_7.2 km in length (hard)_

[![Waterman's Brook Trail](https://www.townoffogoisland.ca/mwm_files/home/sys/media/1535465736.jpg)](https://www.townoffogoisland.ca/mwm_files/home/sys/large/1535465736.jpg "Waterman's Brook Trail")

## Waterman's Brook Trail

Begins in Fogo and ends in Deep Bay - Includes beautiful scenery and ends

in a captivating waterfall.

_8.2 km return (moderate)_

![Deep Bay Trail Head](https://www.townoffogoisland.ca/mwm_files/home/sys/media/1568220407.jpg)

## Deep Bay Trail

Walking trail and lookout.

_1 km return (easy)_
